text:
Leah Ramos: Quick heads-up 	6:15 UTC	77: we started getting inbound 401/403s on onboarding webhooks for EU tenants after an automated key rotation. Initial count: ~120 tenants with repeated webhook failures. Opening thread to sync customer comms.
Marco Ortiz: Thanks Leah. Any immediate mitigation?
Saira Patel: Evidence points to the key-rotation step not triggering a config reload on webhook-proxy instances in eu-west, so proxies kept signing with the old key. Some worker instances expired their cached tokens and started failing.
Ben Cho: Mitigation done: rolled webhook-proxy with forced config-reload and ran a rolling restart of onboarding-workers in eu-west. Backpressure drained, retry queue processing resumed. Spot checks show replays succeeding.
Leah Ramos: Good. We need a short, plain-language status note for customers and a tailored high-touch template for our top 15 accounts. Proposed tone: transparent, apologetic, short timeline, what we fixed, next steps, compensation offer.
Marco Ortiz: Agreed. For high-touch: offer 1:1 enablement + configurable onboarding credit. For self-serve: 10% credit and link to incident form.
Saira Patel: Timeline snippet for comms: 02:10 UTC detection -> 02:18 UTC mitigation deploy -> 02:40 UTC retry queue catch-up -> 03:00 UTC monitoring normal. Will collect logs and a concise RCA paragraph. Sample log entries for the customer-facing timeline:```
2026-03-23T02:12:03Z webhook-proxy WARN signature_mismatch tenant=tenant-345
2026-03-23T02:18:21Z control-plane INFO trigger rolling-restart eu-west
2026-03-23T02:22:10Z onboarding-worker INFO replay_success tenant=tenant-345
```
Ben Cho: Confirmed no persistent data loss; messages were queued and retried. No customer data dropped; ingestion resumed for most tenants.
Leah Ramos: Drafting two short templates now. Will post links to GDoc. Action items: Leah 	6 drafting templates and sending for legal/finance sign-off; Marco 	6 compile impacted-account list & priority flagging; Saira 	6 produce one-paragraph RCA + logs; Ben 	6 confirm credit caps with finance; incident-bot 	6 we'll link cleared alert.
incident-bot: Alert: onboarding-webhook-4xx rate returned to baseline at 1779999200.
Leah Ramos: Proposed schedule: high-touch emails go out in 45 minutes with office hours invite at 15:00 UTC tomorrow for any follow-ups. Bulk status email to rest after high-touch send. Include survey link for 'did this impact your onboarding timeline?'.
Marco Ortiz: Finance okayed credits up to $4k/account for verified high-touch impact. Please tag accounts requiring >$500.
Saira Patel: I'll add a short remediation item in the RCA: ensure key-rotation workflow triggers a service-config-reload event and add a post-rotation smoke test for webhook signing. Also adding `auth:rotation:mismatch` alert.
Ben Cho: I'll prepare a short ops runbook entry and point to the hotfix PR for the proxy.
Leah Ramos: Thanks team. I9ll publish the customer status drafts in the GDoc and loop legal. We'll publish a formal RCA to #postmortems after office hours and include the follow-up timeline. Closing this thread; will post RCA link when ready. :white_check_mark:
